svg.title: LinguaFlow - team project, realtime multilingual chat with AI translation
svg.desc: LinguaFlow, case study 01. Team project by Group 4U (VinUni AI20K Build Phase, six weeks, four people). My role: Backend plus the knowledge base. Realtime multilingual chat with context-aware AI translation: users chat in their own language and the system translates for each participant. Highlights: real-time translation using recent conversation context; WebSocket reconnection with idempotent delivery; voice messages with transcription. Also: direct and group chat, per-user preferred language, automatic source-language detection, human-approved assistant proposals for tasks and calendar. 53 golden test cases for translation evaluation. Live deployment. Team artwork: the LinguaFlow wordmark, the Vietnamese tagline Dịch tin nhắn đa ngôn ngữ Real-time and a parrot mascot among translation symbols. Stack: Python, FastAPI, LangGraph and LangChain, PostgreSQL with pgvector, WebSocket, JWT, Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Docker.
